note: Daily-fee RV park inside Sandy Point, a gated year-round resort community on the south-west shore of Gull Lake about 5 km from Bentley, beside its seasonal lots. The sites are long gravel back-ins on both sides of one straight road, with a bathhouse and playground; the office end is across the road from the public beach. The resort also has an inland marina and boat launch, walking trails and a golf course. Pets in designated areas only. --Claude
